analysis.summary: The project is a small Python 2 sales report generator script supported by a formatting helper utility. It reads a configuration file, fetches sales data from a URL using urllib2, parses it using eval, and prints formatted regional summaries.
components: report.py: Main script containing configuration loading via ConfigParser, URL fetching via urllib2, dynamic evaluation via eval, and summary generation.
utils.py: Helper module containing formatting and chunking utilities (format_money, chunks).
risks: report.py line 10: eval(response.read()) evaluates arbitrary code from a network response, representing a severe security risk.

steps.title: Migrate utils.py to Python 3
steps.description: Update utils.py to use Python 3 compatible syntax, replacing xrange with range and unicode with str if applicable.
steps.notes: Migrated utils.py from Python 2 to Python 3 by replacing long with int, unicode with str, and xrange with range.

steps.title: Migrate report.py imports and syntax
steps.description: Update report.py to use configparser instead of ConfigParser, urllib.request instead of urllib2, print functions, ast.literal_eval for safe evaluation instead of eval, and updated dict methods like items and in.
steps.notes: Migrated report.py to Python 3. Replaced urllib2 with urllib.request/urllib.error, ConfigParser with configparser, eval with ast.literal_eval, updated dict has_key and iteritems to modern syntax, and updated print statements to function calls.
